a simultaneous 4D gradient enhanced and sensitivity enhanced [13C, 15N]-separation NOESY is a more efficient method than collecting two 4D NOESY data sets separately, and that the two data sets can be deconvoluted during data processing.
the interleaved collection of two 4D gradient enhanced NOESY experiments is a factor of two more sensitive than collection of each of the two experiments separately.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new methods for the simultaneous acquisition of 4D NOESY spectra with different 15N and/or 13C spectral widths.
the development and implementation of multidimensional NMR methods for the structure determination of biological macromolecules.
the development of new NMR methods for the study of proteins.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the simultaneous acquisition of 4D [13C, 15N]- and 4D [15N, 15N] separated NOESY spectra is a very powerful tool to obtain the maximum amount of information in the minimum amount of time.

this method is a very attractive alternative to the more commonly used sequential acquisition of the 4D spectra, and that this is particularly true for the case of a 4-4-1-1 data set, where the F2 dimension is the most sensitive one.
this method provides a more efficient way to obtain both [13C, 15N] and [15N15N]-seperated 4D NOESY spectra of proteins.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a new method for simultaneous acquisition of two 4D experiments with a factor of two in the number of increments in the F1 dimension and a factor of two1/2 in the total number of scans.
we have developed an efficient and robust 4D NOESY pulse sequence for the study of proteins in solution.
we are able to acquire the 4D [13C, 15N]-[15N, 15N] separated NOESY in 2 days with a 1.1 mM protein sample, which is a significant improvement over the previously reported 4D NOESY experiments.
The main takeaway from our work is that

it is feasible to collect two 4D gradient enhanced and sensitivity enhanced [13C, 15N] and [15N-15N] NOESY spectra simultaneously, and that the processing of these data sets to yield two 4D deconvolved data sets is relatively straightforward.
simultaneous data acquisition is a powerful tool for the acquisition of multidimensional spectra in proteins.
it is possible to collect a [13C, 15N]-seleced and a [15N, 15N] selected 4D spectrum in a single experiment, which is a factor (3/2) more sensitive than the separate acquisition of the two spectra.
